description.en: Stage local 3D models with ready-to-use lighting presets, camera views and manual controls. Cherry AI is optional.
description.zh: 用现成灯光方案、快捷机位和手动微调为本地 3D 模型布景，无需配置 AI。

releaseNotes.en: Upgrades Skenora to 0.1.3 with local rain, snow and drifting-particle presets, bundled textures, density controls and safe preset restoration. Imported models remain session-only.
releaseNotes.zh: 升级 Skenora 0.1.3，接入雨幕、飘雪、漂浮光点与随包贴图，支持密度调节、撤销和安全恢复；导入模型仍仅当前会话保留。
